title: Northgate Business Bulk Gift Card Terms of Sale
content:
**Terms.** Business bulk orders of Northgate Business Bulk Gift Cards, within the Northgate Gift Cards and Merchandise Return Cards program, are placed by business profiles for at least the type's smallest bulk order and at most the type's most cards in one order, paid by ACH, check or a Northgate Business Card, or charged to a Northgate Business invoice account where the type allows a bulk order to be charged to such an account. The order earns the bulk discount set for its total value, and the cards activate once the order is paid. The cards then follow the same rules as any other card.

## The terms in parts

| Element | Term |
|---|---|
| Who places the order | a business profile |
| Order size | at least the smallest bulk order in value, and at most the most cards in one order |
| Payment | ACH, check or a Northgate Business Card; or a charge to a Northgate Business invoice account where the type allows it |
| Discount | the bulk discount for the order's total value, the band being read on the total value of the whole order |
| Activation | the cards activate once the order is paid |
| After activation | the cards follow the same rules as any other card |

## Points of the terms

**Can a consumer profile place a bulk order?** No; bulk orders are placed by business profiles.

**When do the cards on a bulk order become active?** Once the order is paid.

## Illustration (hypothetical order)

A business profile orders 40 Northgate Business Bulk Gift Cards of 50.00 each, a total value of 2000.00, and pays by check. The discount is the one set for an order totalling 2000.00, and all 40 cards activate when the check payment completes the order's payment.
